title: Paradiski Catalog Curation

Added a shared Paradiski terrain domain for aggregate pass-accessible terrain and default pass products for both destinations, while keeping local child ski-area records scoped to their existing weather-evidence units. Lodging, stay-base quality, supported skill, and rental price-quality estimates remain unchanged pending a dedicated sampling policy.

validation_commands: UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --no-config python -m app.data.compare_ranking --output-dir artifacts/ranking-comparison
ranking_comparison_summary: Ran `UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --no-config python -m app.data.compare_ranking --output-dir artifacts/ranking-comparison`; output had 12 rows across 11 result groups. The current representative scenarios did not include Les Arcs or La Plagne, so there was no direct Paradiski row to compare; the change remains ranking-relevant for future search-v2 diagnostics because those destinations can now derive accessible terrain from `terrain-domain:paradiski`.
unresolved_caveats: La Plagne's official online shop page was open for weekly-pass structure review but did not publish selectable prices at the time of curation; La Plagne uses representative shared-domain adult prices from the linked official Les Arcs Paradiski ticket page.

Paradiski lift count and difficulty split remain unresolved because the reviewed official pages consistently supported the 425 km linked piste total but did not expose a stable aggregate lift count or piste-kilometer difficulty breakdown in the same scoped source set.
Stay-base quality, supported skill levels, lodging price ranges, rental examples, and rental price-quality fields remain estimates pending a dedicated sampling policy.
